dedupe_keys.name: philippines pre disaster indicators by city and municipality housing materials water sanitation health facilities

description: OCHA Philippines keeps a set of pre-disaster baseline indicators for every city and municipality of the Philippines on the Humanitarian Data Exchange, so responders can compare affected areas with their situation before a disaster. The workbooks cover the number of households and barangays, the construction materials of outer walls and roofs, the source of drinking water and the kind of toilet facility from the Philippine Statistics Authority's 2015 census of population and housing, health facilities by type from the Department of Health's 2019 national facility registry, health personnel from the 2017 human resources database, public school enrolment for 2017 to 2018, conditional cash transfer beneficiaries from DSWD and evacuation centres from DILG. Coverage: all cities and municipalities. Access: Excel workbooks on HDX. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: sources have different reference years, and the provider notes that its visualisation does not reflect later updates to health personnel, enrolment and cash-transfer data. Simulation uses are wall and roof material shares as a proxy for housing vulnerability in typhoon and earthquake damage models, and facility counts for response planning. Related records: the 510 Typhoon Haima priority index and TM Open Buildings.
